n01.roman: Game mein ek button: driver bahar, gaadi aapki. Par asli kanoon kya kehta hai?

n06.roman: Sirf koshish ki? Phir bhi 7 saal tak. Aur loot mein kisi ko jaan-boojhkar chot pahunchaayi? To umrqaid tak!
